sloka: सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्वं हि धर्मात्मन् गत्वा तस्याश्रमं मुनेः ।दृष्टवांश्च तदा तां स्त्रीं दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव ।। ७.३०.३० ॥
transliteration: saṅkruddhastvaṁ hi dharmātman gatvā tasyāśramaṁ muneḥ ।dṛṣṭavāṁśca tadā tāṁ strīṁ dīptāmagniśikhāmiva ।। 7.30.30 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, you, being very angry, O righteous one, went to that sage's hermitage and then saw that woman shining like a flame of fire.
